predictions.description: oracle in-context retrieval of source passage
predictions.reasoning: Model can attend to in-context content; <NAME> suppression still active in output logits. Plot facts easier than names because plot tokens don't trigger the suppression.
Adapter modifies FFN weights that produce the suppressed logits; bypasses output-level bias that RAG cannot.

predictions.description: no adapter, no engram; prepend instruction not to emit <NAME>

strong_predictions.C3_beats_C2_on_names_by_at_least_10pp: D2L installs content at the manifold level (FFN weights), beating RAG which can only inject content at the prompt level and still gets routed through the suppressed output stage.
strong_predictions.C4_strictly_greater_than_C3: Engram prefix provides additional bias toward the adapter-warped trajectory region; if it doesn't help, the engram-as-bias framework's compositional claim needs revisiting.

success_criteria_for_architectural_claim.C3_minus_C2_on_names_at_least_10pp: manifold-level beats prompt-level on suppressed content
